name: Y Adventure Camp at Rock Point
description_short: A co-ed outdoor day camp run by the Greater Burlington YMCA on the Rock Point property on Lake Champlain. Campers swim, kayak, garden, hike and do arts and STEM activities, and each week has a theme.
refund_policy_summary: If you cancel 2 or more weeks before the start date, you get back any tuition paid but not the deposit. If you cancel within 2 weeks of the start, you get nothing back. The $30 registration fee and the $25 per-week deposit are non-refundable. The exception: if a family cancels because camp is still too expensive after a Y scholarship, the registration fee and deposit are refunded.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim and kayak in Lake Champlain. Water activities depend on safe cyanobacteria levels, which are checked every day before campers go in.

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season, which ended before today (2026-10-13). There are no 2027 dates or prices yet. All dates and prices are from 2026.
Minimum eligibility is 'completed 2nd grade', which is a grade, not an age. grade_min and age_min are left empty.
Session prices are the 5-day rate ($425). A 3-day option is $315 per week. On top of that there is a one-time $30 registration fee per child and a 2.5% fee on card payments.
Not state-licensed, so Vermont State Child Care Financial Assistance subsidies cannot be used here.
